title: Tax and insurance
learning_outcomes: Explain tax concepts in the context of tax and insurance.
Compare and distinguish insurance pooling in the context of tax and insurance.
Apply exclusions in the context of tax and insurance.
Evaluate and justify decisions about local rules in the context of tax and insurance.

lessons.title: Tax concepts
lessons.outcome: Explain tax concepts in the context of tax and insurance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving tax concepts; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to tax and insurance question brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain tax concepts from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of tax concepts; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Insurance pooling
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish insurance pooling in the context of tax and insurance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving insurance pooling; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to tax and insurance question brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain insurance pooling from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of insurance pooling; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Exclusions
lessons.outcome: Apply exclusions in the context of tax and insurance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving exclusions; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to tax and insurance question brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain exclusions from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of exclusions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Local rules
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about local rules in the context of tax and insurance.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving local rules; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to tax and insurance question brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain local rules from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of local rules; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of tax concepts; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of insurance pooling; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of exclusions; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of local rules; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
